subject: Recap + asks: audit log scope, DPA mapping and retention options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@paylane.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@paylane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: audit log scope & DPA mapping — PayLane intro call

Hi Claire / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time this morning — good discussion. Quick recap of the items we covered and the asks we heard from your security/compliance team so we can align next steps.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit logs: you need fine-grained request-level logs (request_id, user_id, model_id, timestamps) retained for a minimum of 24 months for regulatory reporting.
- SOC 2: proof of current SOC 2 posture and list of in-scope controls (Type II preferred).
- DPA / subprocessor mapping: you need a version of our DPA with explicit subprocessor list and ability to negotiate limited redlines.
- Pen test & retention: you asked whether we support customer-conducted penetration tests, and what the standard retention/archival policy is for backups/audit artifacts.

Immediate asks (next steps we agreed):
1) Redwood to provide SOC 2 executive summary + evidence catalog stub.
2) Share a small sample (redacted) audit log extract so your engineers can validate fields/format.
3) Provide a DPA redline proposal and indicate which clauses are negotiable vs. standard.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (Laura) to review audit log schema and retention mechanics.
5) Confirm pen-test window options and rules-of-engagement (ROE).

Proposed timeline: we can deliver the SOC 2 exec summary + audit log sample by EOD Monday (2027-04-19). DPA redline proposal the following day. Tech deep-dive suggested Wed 2027-04-21 (30–45m). Pen-test windows we can propose two options in July (tentative).

If that aligns, I’ll attach the listed artifacts and send invites for the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOC2-ask-list (we'll attach the summary + audit log sample in the follow-up).

From: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@paylane.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@paylane.com>, security@paylane.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 14:30:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: audit log scope & DPA mapping — PayLane intro call

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the clear summary — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications from the security team:
- Retention: 24 months is our minimum for audit logs; some regulators may request access beyond that, so we need a path to extended retention (either export or paid extension).
- Log fields: confirm audit logs include request_id, caller_user_id (or equivalent), model identifier, and full timestamp (UTC). We also need sample retention metadata (where logs are stored, how they are archived).
- Encryption: please confirm encryption at rest + KMS support (customer-managed key if Private deployment).
- Pen test: we prefer a customer-led pen test (scoped) with an embargoed report sent to us; please confirm whether that is allowed and what constraints exist (NDA, blackout dates).

We appreciate the proposed dates — Monday works for the artifacts. For the tech deep-dive, Wed 21st is okay for a 30–45 minute session; Laura from your side is good.

Claire
Head of Security Operations | PayLane Financial
claire.holmes@paylane.com

(P.S. Tom will coordinate DPA redline reviewers internally.)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@paylane.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@paylane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:02:15 -0700
Subject: Deliverables: SOC2 exec summary, audit-log sample & DPA redline (attachments)

Claire / Tom — attaching the items we discussed. See inline answers to your clarifying questions below and proposed owners/timing.

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-Redwood-Exec-Summary-2026.pdf (attestation, in-scope systems, control categories)
- Audit-log-sample-2026.json (redacted example — includes request_id, caller_id, model_id, tokens_returned, timestamp_utc, region)
- DPA-redline-proposal-paylane.docx (our suggested redlines + notes on negotiable clauses)

Quick answers to Claire’s questions:
- Retention: Hosted API default retention for audit logs is 24 months for accounts on enterprise plans. For long-term retention (beyond 24 months) we offer an export service or dedicated retention add-on (can be included in Dedicated/Private deployments).
- Log fields: sample contains request_id, caller_user_id (hashed for hosted; raw in Private on request), model_id, endpoint, response_size_tokens, timestamp_utc, and request_metadata (redacted).
- Encryption & KMS: all logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256). For Dedicated/Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP Cloud KMS).
- Pen test: We support customer-conducted pen tests under an ROE. We require a short pre-engagement questionnaire, an approved blackout window, and an embargoed final report shared under NDA. We cannot permit destructive testing against production endpoints without a pre-approved plan; we can offer a dedicated staging environment for the test.

Proposed owners & next steps:
- SOC2 exec summary + audit log sample (DELIVERED) — owner: Soojin (action: review & confirm fields)
- DPA redline proposal (DELIVERED) — owner: Legal (Karthik will coordinate external review)
- Technical deep-dive (audit schema & retention mechanics) — owner: Laura Bennett; proposed time: Wed 2027-04-21 10:00–10:30 PT
- Pen-test ROE and scheduling — owner: Security Ops (PayLane) + Redwood security; proposed windows: 10–17 Jul 2027 or 24–31 Jul 2027

If that looks good I’ll send the calendar invite for Wed and loop in our legal lead on the DPA thread.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Redwood-Exec-Summary-2026.pdf (attached), Audit-log-sample-2026.json (attached), DPA-redline-proposal-paylane.docx (attached)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@paylane.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@paylane.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverables: SOC2 exec summary, audit-log sample & DPA redline (attachments)

Claire / Tom — quick note from legal and sales ops side. We confirm:
- Deal/ops note: We can commit to 24-month audit-log retention on enterprise plans and Dedicated/Private deployments (we'll include a retention SLA in the contract).
- Hosted customers can have extended retention via a paid add-on or export workflow; we'll document the export format and costs.
- DPA: our redline doc highlights three negotiable clauses (data location, subprocessor notice period, and liability cap for data incidents). We typically handle these when customers move to a commitment.

Next step ask for PayLane: please confirm whether you want retention as an included term in the quote (preferred) or as an add-on. Also confirm preferred deep-dive time so Laura can send an invite.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

--
Note: attachments are redacted stubs for intake. Full artifact delivery will follow our secure share process once NDA/engagement terms are accepted.
